commands.name: newProject
commands.summary: Create and compile an editable project in the configured project root.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Namespace; its final dot-separated component becomes the project name. Use a unique name and an owned root for automation.

commands.result: Object {displayName:string,homeSymbolId:GUID string}. Does not itself open the project.
commands.effects: Writes project files and compiles/loads its package; failures can leave files. Names are passed to existing project setup; this endpoint is not a sandbox.
commands.completion: Synchronous; compilation blocks the main thread. A timeout does not cancel creation.

commands.name: openProject
commands.summary: Open a loaded package by display name or explicit home symbol.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Case-insensitive package display name or short prefix before ' ('. First matching package wins.

arguments.name: symbolId
arguments.description: Takes precedence over name whenever present; malformed text fails rather than falling back. May address a loaded symbol as explicit home.

arguments.name: pinOutput
arguments.description: Pin the root when a primary output window exists; false does not clear an existing pin.

commands.result: Object {rootSymbolId:GUID string|null,rootSymbolName:string|null,pinnedOutput:boolean}. pinnedOutput describes this call, not whether any output was already pinned.
commands.effects: Creates project view state, resolves package instances and may pin output; opening can load resources and evaluate operators.
commands.completion: Immediate after view assignment; later rendering continues.

commands.name: reload
commands.summary: Recompile and reload an existing editable project.

arguments.name: project
arguments.description: Case-insensitive display name or short prefix before ' ('; only EditableSymbolProject entries are considered.

commands.result: Object {durationSeconds:number}, rounded to one decimal place. Failure detail contains compiler diagnostics when available.
commands.effects: Saves/rebuilds package state and replaces runtime instances. Built-in compiled packages require restart. Resolve symbols and children by GUID again after reload.
commands.completion: Synchronous main-thread compile; allow a generous bounded client timeout. Timeout is not cancellation.
